knowledge_used.how_applied: Procedure steps 1-4 and 6 followed (envelope, capacitor current/dQ/I_rms at every corner, film selection for C/V/I_rms, HV ceramics beside the leg, hand-off to layout). Step 5 (DC blocking) skipped. The DAB rectified-tank waveform is replaced by the buck's pulsating input current (Io during D, zero otherwise, plus ripple) and the triangular output current.
C >= dQ_max/dV applied with dQ = D(1-D)*Io*Ts derived for the buck and evaluated at all nine corners (worst 137.5 uC at 400 V / 27.5 A); dV from the 2 % ripple assumption.

I_Cin,rms computed at 50 kHz and compared with datasheet I_RMS ratings normalised to their temperature-rise bases (TDK dT 20 K at 70 degC, KEMET dT 30 K, Vishay dT 15 K at 85 degC); self-heating recomputed from ESR and R_th at 50 degC ambient.

Two-tier bank: 2 x 20 uF film plus 10 x 0.47 uF 630 V 2220 ceramics beside the half-bridge; ceramic quantity derived from the edge-charge / film-interconnect resonance model, not copied from TI's 14 pieces.
No transformer or tank inductance in a non-isolated buck; no DC-blocking capacitor.
Ceramic tier placement and loop-inductance target (<= 20 nH) given priority over gate-driver routing; stated as PCB constraints 1-2.
Film capacitors connected with >= 20 mm wide Vin+/PGND pours on at least two 70 um layers with via stitching; current density computed (5 A/mm2 at 7 A RMS).

Provisional functional-insulation spacing (>= 2.5 mm creepage, >= 1.5 mm clearance, 3.0 mm recommended) stated for 440 V DC working voltage, PD2, CTI >= 175; the governing values must be derived from the standard by the isolation agent and reviewed.
DC+, PGND and SW nets of the capacitor banks assigned to spacing classes so KiCad class-pair clearances can be encoded.
At 440 V working voltage the required creepage is small enough that slots are not needed around the capacitor pads; revisit only if the isolation agent's values are larger.
Principle 1 (power loop first) used to place the ceramic tier at the TO-247 pins and define the loop target.

Step 3: film capacitors and bleeders kept out of the heat-sink exhaust; the knowledge base itself marks this recommendation as without source evidence, so it is listed for review and a 10 K local-air allowance is carried.
Concerns the MOSFET heat-sink interface, not capacitors; only the thermal environment it creates is considered.

Decision 2: two-tier architecture and dQ -> C method reused; instance values (30/60 uF, 5 V ripple, 14 MLCC, B32716 parts, 630 V/1 kV choices) not copied. Decision 3 not applicable. Decision 10: bus copper repeated on several layers adopted as a pattern. Voltage ratios TI used (0.625, 0.73) noted as observations only.
Different TDK series (B32716) with no datasheet in the knowledge base; replaced by the B32776 37.5 mm 4-pin series after fetching the TDK datasheet.
1.1 kV part for an 800 V link; not needed at 440 V.

Same TDK 630 V X7T 2220 part family selected for the HF tier at a 0.70 voltage ratio (TI used it at 0.79); quantity derived (10), DC-bias derating added as an explicit assumption because the curve could not be fetched; availability flagged.
Knowles 1 kV 0.47 uF 2220 listed as the higher-margin alternate (KXTWS2 FlexiCap variant); specifications only at search-snippet level.
TI's 0.1 uF 1 kV 1812 positions are snubber/local decoupling in an 800 V stage; no such positions are defined here.
HF input capacitors (ceramic tier) placed within 5-15 mm of the half-bridge pins; evidence to be a pad-to-pad current-path overlay at layout review.
Commutation-loop target <= 20 nH including packages; loop overlay including layer transitions required as evidence.
Copper width and via stitching for the film-capacitor branches sized from the computed 7 A RMS per branch and 25 A bus current.
Interface only: the input voltage-sense divider parallels the bleeder; its value is set by the sensing agent and is not credited in the discharge time.

calculations.name: Duty and inductor ripple at corners
Input ripple charge
calculations.expression: dQ = D*(1-D)*Io*Ts (exact since Io - dI/2 > D*Io at all corners)

calculations.name: Input capacitance requirement
calculations.expression: C_in >= dQ_max / dV; dV = 2 % x 400 V = 8 V; nominal = C_min / 0.9
calculations.result: C_in >= 17.2 uF; >= 19.1 uF nominal (1 % target would need 34.4 uF / 38.2 uF nominal)

calculations.name: Input film RMS margin and self-heating
calculations.expression: I_part = I_Cin,rms/2; P = I_part^2 * ESR; R_th = dT_rated/(I_rated^2*ESR); dT = P*R_th; T_hs = 50 + 10 + dT
calculations.result: TDK: 0.48 of rating, 0.36 W, R_th 12.7 K/W, dT 4.6 K, T_hs 65 degC; KEMET: 0.40, 0.23 W, dT 4.1 K; Vishay: 0.58, 0.29 W, dT 5.0 K; single 40 uF KEMET: 0.48 W, dT 6.2 K

calculations.name: HF ceramic tier requirement
calculations.expression: f_r = 1/(2 pi sqrt(L_int C_eff)); dQ = I_pk * (1/(4 f_r)); dV = dQ/C_eff; Z0 = sqrt(L_int/C_eff)
calculations.result: 1.88 uF, 30 nH: f_r 670 kHz, T/4 373 ns, dQ 11.7 uC, dV 6.2 V (1.5 %), Z0 0.13 Ohm; 1.0 uF, 30 nH: dV 8.5 V (2.1 %) -> require C_eff >= 1.5 uF

calculations.name: HF ceramic effective capacitance and count
calculations.result: C_eff >= 1.88 uF (4.7 uF nominal)

calculations.name: Ceramic current share
calculations.expression: I_cer,50k = I_Cin,rms * C_eff/(C_film,min + C_eff); I_hf,rms = sqrt(2 fs * I_pk^2 t_edge/3)
calculations.result: 5 % share: 0.69 A total, 69 mA per piece; HF edges 1.28 A total, 0.13 A per piece

calculations.name: Commutation overshoot vs loop inductance
calculations.result: 15-30 V at 1 A/ns, 30-60 V at 2 A/ns -> target L_loop <= 20 nH including two TO-247-4 packages

calculations.name: Output capacitor RMS current
calculations.result: 2.16 A / 2.86 A; per part 1.43 A vs 23.5 A rating; P = 7 mW

calculations.name: Output capacitance for ripple
calculations.result: 12.5 uF (not limiting); realised 0.23 + 0.02 = 0.25 Vpp (0.12 %) with 108 uF

calculations.name: Output capacitance for load step
calculations.expression: C >= dI_step / (2 pi fc (dV_max - ESR*dI_step)); nominal = C/0.9
calculations.result: 99.7 / 79.8 / 66.5 uF -> 110.8 / 88.6 / 73.8 uF nominal; selected 120 uF nominal (108 uF min): 9.2 V at 2 kHz, 7.4 V at 2.5 kHz

calculations.name: Output load-dump excursion vs OVP
calculations.expression: dV = 25 A / (2 pi fc C_min) + ESR*25 A
calculations.result: +18.5 V / +14.8 V -> 218.5 V / 214.8 V against the 220 V OVP trip (open issue)

calculations.name: Inductor slew and LC corner
calculations.expression: di/dt = (Vin - Vout)/L; f0 = 1/(2 pi sqrt(L C))
calculations.result: 0.60 A/us (12.5 A in 21 us, faster than the loop); f0 = 889 Hz

calculations.name: Output voltage derating ratios
calculations.result: 0.44 / 0.49 / 0.98 (fault survivable within V_op,85 = 450 V)

calculations.name: Electrolytic lifetime estimate (comparison only)
calculations.result: 96,000 / 68,000 / 48,000 h — outside the knowledge base; not used for selection

calculations.name: Bleeder discharge time (coupled banks)
calculations.expression: numerical two-bank RC decay with ideal diode clamp when Vout - Vin > 0.7 V; t until both < 60 V
calculations.result: 35.7 s (480k/240k: 47.6 s; 300k/200k: 31.0 s); input alone 35.7 s; output alone from 220 V 34.3 s

calculations.name: Bleeder dissipation and element stress
calculations.result: input 0.54 W at 440 V (0.44 W at 400 V), 0.18 W and 147 V (160 V at 480 V) per resistor vs 1 W / 500 V; output 0.20 W, 0.10 W and 100-110 V per resistor; standby total 0.74 W

calculations.name: Film-branch copper

inputs.I: 7 A RMS per branch; 25 A bus

calculations.result: 1.4 mm2 per layer; 5.0 A/mm2 (7 A), 17.9 A/mm2 (25 A, one layer) -> use two layers

assumptions_added.name: A1 Input ripple target
assumptions_added.value: <= 2 % pk-pk of Vin (8 Vpp at 400 V); realised about 1 %
assumptions_added.basis: Keeps asynchronous ADC sampling error of the input-voltage feedforward within +/-1 %, keeps 440 V + ripple/2 + overshoot below the 460 V OVP, limits the 50 kHz component at the input terminals; comparable to the 1 % TI achieved on the 500 V DAB link (observation, not copied).

assumptions_added.name: A2 Voltage-loop crossover
assumptions_added.value: fc = 2.5 kHz design (fs/20), 2.0 kHz checked as the lower bound
assumptions_added.basis: One-sample-delay digital loop on the F28335 with an inner average-current loop; typical 1/20-1/25 of fs; inductor slew is faster than the loop so C dominates the excursion.

assumptions_added.name: A3 Discharge criterion
assumptions_added.value: < 60 V within 60 s after disconnection, with a warning label stating the time
assumptions_added.basis: IEC 61800-5-1 clause 4.3.11 / IEC 62477-1 clause 4.4.9 permit a longer discharge time with marking when 5 s is impracticable; 5 s would need about 3 W continuous or an active discharge (human review).

assumptions_added.name: A4 MLCC DC-bias derating
assumptions_added.value: <= 60 % capacitance loss at 440 V for the TDK 630 V X7T 2220 part (40 % remaining, 0.19 uF per piece)
assumptions_added.basis: Shape of high-voltage X7T characteristics plotted by TDK around the 315 V reference; the curve itself could not be fetched (HTTP 403) and must be read before release.

assumptions_added.name: A5 HF tier capacitance requirement
assumptions_added.value: C_eff >= 1.5 uF at bias so the bus dip during a 31 A edge stays <= 2 % with 30 nH film interconnect
assumptions_added.basis: Quarter-period charge model of the film-to-ceramic resonance; conservative because the film path begins to supply current before T/4.

assumptions_added.name: A6 Local air temperature around film capacitors
assumptions_added.value: +10 K above the 50 degC ambient (60 degC) before self-heating
assumptions_added.basis: Film capacitors placed out of the heat-sink exhaust per SKILL-006 step 3; allowance to be confirmed by measurement.

assumptions_added.name: A7 Switching edge and interconnect
assumptions_added.value: 31.3 A commutated in 30-50 ns (about 1 A/ns); film-to-ceramic interconnect 20-40 nH; loop target <= 20 nH
assumptions_added.basis: Typical TO-247-4 SiC hard-switching edges with gate resistors in the ohms range; to be replaced by the gate-driver agent's dv/dt and the layout extraction.

assumptions_added.name: A8 Film capacitance tolerance
assumptions_added.basis: TDK ordering-code tolerance K = +/-10 %; J (+/-5 %) parts would raise C_min.

assumptions_added.name: A9 Working voltage for spacing
assumptions_added.value: 440 V DC continuous between Vin+ and PGND (480 V transient), functional insulation, PD2, CTI >= 175
assumptions_added.basis: Design basis values; distances to be derived by the isolation agent (KR-ISO-002).

assumptions_added.name: A10 Rating-basis normalisation
assumptions_added.value: 10 kHz film I_RMS ratings used unchanged at 50 kHz; heating checked with ESR x R_th
assumptions_added.basis: Vishay 26015 footnote 3 (ESR flat 10-70 kHz for P = 37.5 mm); TDK and KEMET define the rating as a thermal limit (dT 20 K / 30 K at 70 degC).

pcb_constraints: C_HF ceramics: first row within 5 mm, second row within 15 mm of the TO-247-4 high-side drain and low-side source pins, distributed on both sides of the device row; Vin+ and PGND as overlapping pours on adjacent layers beneath them (KR-CAP-003, KR-PCB-004, PE-PCB-002).
Commutation loop (C_HF -> HS drain -> SW -> LS source -> PGND -> C_HF) target <= 20 nH including packages; evidence: full loop overlay with layer transitions (PE-PCB-003).

Film capacitors C_IN1/2 within 30-40 mm of the half-bridge, one per side; C_OUT1/2 at the inductor output; connections as >= 20 mm wide Vin+/PGND (and Vout/PGND) pours on at least two 70 um layers, via-stitched, all four pins tied to both layers (KR-PCB-006, PE-PCB-006).

Custom 4-pad footprints: C_IN pads at (+/-18.75, +/-5.10) mm, C_OUT pads at (+/-18.75, +/-10.15) mm, drill 1.6 mm, pad 3.0 mm, courtyards 28 x 42 mm and 30 x 45 mm plus clearance, heights 37 / 45 mm; library C_Rect_L41.5mm_W*_P37.50mm 2-pin footprints do not fit.

Spacing between Vin+ and PGND (440 V DC working, 480 V transient): provisional >= 2.5 mm creepage / >= 1.5 mm clearance, 3.0 mm recommended around capacitor pads and bleeder chains; final values from the isolation agent per KR-ISO-002 (human review); 2220 pad gap about 3.5-4 mm.
Bleeder resistors routed as straight series chains along the capacitor edge, <= 160 V per 2512 element, away from gate-driver areas; discharge-time marking near the input terminals.
Keep film capacitors and bleeders out of the heat-sink exhaust (SKILL-006 step 3); if unavoidable, re-measure the local air temperature against assumption A6.
Net classes: DC_PLUS (Vin+), PGND, SW, VOUT assigned to spacing classes so KiCad class-pair clearance rules can be generated (KR-ISO-003).
Board partition: all capacitors and bleeders remain on the power board regardless of the architecture choice; only the sense-divider/bleeder interface touches the control board.
Mechanical: film capacitor height 37-45 mm sets the minimum power-board component envelope; keep the inductor and connectors clear of the film-capacitor footprints.
open_issues: MLCC DC-bias capacitance at 440 V for TDK CGA9P1X7T2J474M250KC is unverified (TDK pages blocked); if the remaining capacitance is below 40 %, increase the count or switch to the 1 kV Knowles alternate.

Availability of CGA9P1X7T2J474M250KC conflicts between distributors (Avnet zero stock / 168-week lead; SnapEda lists Newark stock); procurement check needed; K250KC (+/-10 %) is an acceptable substitute.

Output OVP at 220 V leaves only 1.5-5 V margin to a full 25 A load dump (214.8-218.5 V); propose raising the trip to about 230 V (15 %) with blanking or increasing C_OUT to 180 uF — to be coordinated with the protection/sensing agent.
Film-to-ceramic bus resonance (about 670 kHz, Z0 0.13 Ohm) is lightly damped; simulate with the extracted interconnect inductance and add a 1 uF + 0.47 Ohm RC leg if ringing exceeds 2 %.
Discharge criterion: the 60 s with-label option is assumed; if the system integrator requires 5 s, an active discharge (relay-switched resistor or converter-assisted) must be added — human review.
Vishay MKP1848C 4-pin ordering-code digit (JP4 vs JP5) must be confirmed if the Vishay alternate is used.
Film capacitor lifetime at the 0.55 (input) and 0.44 (output) voltage ratios should be read from the TDK/KEMET/Vishay lifetime curves; no exponent asserted.
The MOSFET agent's dv/dt and gate-resistor choice set the real edge rate; if di/dt exceeds 2 A/ns, the <= 20 nH loop target becomes mandatory rather than recommended.
The input voltage-sense divider value (SKILL-005 agent) parallels the bleeder; its dissipation and discharge contribution should be added to the final discharge calculation.

Distributor prices of the film capacitors were not verified; the all-film output costs several times the hybrid option — if cost pressure reopens the hybrid, electrolytic lifetime modelling is outside the knowledge base and needs human review.
verification_status: Analytically checked at all nine corners (Vin 360/400/440 V, Io 25/27.5 A, L 267/220 uH): input RMS 13.87 A max, dQ 137.5 uC, C_in 40 uF nominal, ripple 1 %; HF tier model; output RMS 2.86 A, 120 uF for the 12.5 A step; bleeder discharge 35.7 s and 0.74 W. Film capacitors and bleeder resistors verified against fetched manufacturer datasheets (TDK June 2026, KEMET F3114 6/2024 and F3125 8/2021, Vishay 26015 rev 09-Aug-2023, Vishay 20035 rev 14-Apr-2026). MLCC parameters at search-snippet level only; DC-bias curve, availability, interconnect inductance, lifetime at voltage ratio and prices unverified. Human review required for discharge-time option, creepage/clearance values, output OVP margin, ceramic voltage ratio with overshoot, bus damping and heat-sink exhaust placement.

# DC-link input and output capacitor design — 400 V to 200 V, 5 kW, 50 kHz SiC synchronous buck

AI-GENERATED ENGINEERING PROTOTYPE V2 — HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED. Result file: examples/sic-buck-400v-200v-5kw/design/research/capacitors.json.

## 1. Scope and knowledge basis

This section sizes (a) the input DC-link film bank, (b) the high-frequency ceramic tier at the half-bridge, (c) the output bank and (d) the passive discharge (bleeder) resistors. The method is the SKILL-003 procedure, steps 1-4 and 6; step 5 (DC-blocking capacitor, KR-CAP-004) does not apply because there is no transformer. Rules applied: KR-CAP-001 (charge balance, adapted to the buck current waveform), KR-CAP-002 (RMS current at f_sw and temperature, direct), KR-CAP-003 (bulk film plus distributed HV ceramics, direct), KR-PCB-004 with PE-PCB-002/003 (power-loop priority, direct), KR-PCB-006 with PE-PCB-006 (paralleled bus copper, direct), KR-ISO-002/003 (spacing per standard, human review), SKILL-006 step 3 (film capacitors out of the heat-sink exhaust, direct, itself flagged for review in the knowledge base). From REF-TI-TIDA-010054 decision 2 only the two-tier architecture and the dQ -> C method are reused; the instance values (30 uF / 60 uF banks, 5 V ripple target, 14 MLCC per bridge, B32716 parts) are not copied, and the DAB rectified-tank capacitor waveform is replaced by the buck's pulsating input current and triangular output current (adaptation). Electrolytic lifetime modelling is outside the knowledge base (SKILL-003 "not applicable"); it appears only in the technology comparison and is flagged.

## 2. Operating envelope

Vin 360 / 400 / 440 V [SEED], Vout 200 V [USER], Io 25 A with 27.5 A for 10 s [SEED], fs 50 kHz [USER], D = Vout/Vin = 0.556 / 0.500 / 0.455, L = 267 uH nominal with 220 uH as the low bound of the accepted 220-300 uH window [SEED], ambient 50 degC [SEED]. Inductor ripple dI = Vout(1-D)/(L fs): 6.66 A (360 V) / 7.49 A (400 V) / 8.17 A (440 V) at 267 uH and 8.08 / 9.09 / 9.92 A at 220 uH.

## 3. Input DC-link bank

### 3.1 Capacitor current (SKILL-003 step 2; KR-CAP-002)

The high-side switch draws i_L during D*Ts and nothing otherwise; the source supplies Iin = D*Io. Including the inductor ripple, I_Cin,rms = sqrt( D*(Io^2 + dI^2/12) - (D*Io)^2 ).

| Vin (V) | D | Io (A) | Io*sqrt(D(1-D)) (A) | I_Cin,rms, 267 uH (A) | I_Cin,rms, 220 uH (A) | dQ (uC) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 360 | 0.556 | 25.0 | 12.42 | 12.50 | 12.54 | 123.5 |
| 400 | 0.500 | 25.0 | 12.50 | 12.59 | 12.64 | 125.0 |
| 440 | 0.455 | 25.0 | 12.45 | 12.55 | 12.60 | 124.0 |

Worst case 13.87 A RMS at 400 V, 27.5 A, 220 uH; the ripple term adds under 1 % to Io*sqrt(D(1-D)).

### 3.2 Ripple charge and capacitance (KR-CAP-001)

Because Io - dI/2 > D*Io at every corner, the capacitor current is positive during the whole on-time and the ripple charge is exactly dQ = D(1-D)*Io*Ts: 123.5-125 uC at 25 A and 137.5 uC worst case at 400 V / 27.5 A. Ripple target (assumption A1): <= 2 % pk-pk of Vin, i.e. 8 Vpp at 400 V. Justification: it keeps the DSP input-voltage sample error from ripple that is asynchronous to the ADC trigger within +/-1 %, keeps 440 V + half ripple + commutation overshoot well below the 460 V OVP trip, and limits the 50 kHz component presented to the external source; TIDA-010054 achieved about 1 % on its 500 V link (reference observation, not copied). C_in >= 137.5 uC / 8 V = 17.2 uF; with the -10 % tolerance >= 19.1 uF nominal.

### 3.3 RMS rating, technology and count (KR-CAP-002; SKILL-003 principle 2)

13.9 A RMS at 50 kHz excludes aluminium electrolytics (250-450 V snap-ins carry 2-4 A each at 50 kHz) and leads to metallised-polypropylene film. Two capacitors share the current (6.9 A each) and allow one on each side of the half-bridge. Film ratings are given at 10 kHz; for MKP box capacitors the ESR is essentially flat from 10 kHz to about 70-100 kHz (Vishay 26015 footnote 3: ESR typical values valid 10-70 kHz for P = 37.5 mm; TDK defines I_RMS,max as the thermal limit for dT <= 20 K at 70 degC), so the 10 kHz rating is used unchanged at 50 kHz and self-heating is checked through ESR: dT = I^2 * ESR * R_th.

Selected: 2 x TDK B32776G8206K000 (20 uF +/-10 %, V_R,70degC = 800 V DC, V_op,85degC = 700 V DC, I_RMS,max 14.5 A at 70 degC / 10 kHz / dT <= 20 K, ESR 7.5 mOhm typical, ESL 10 nH, 28 x 37 x 42 mm, lead spacing 37.5 mm, P1 = 10.2 mm, 4 pins; TDK datasheet B3277*D/E/G/J/T dated June 2026). Per capacitor: 6.92 A = 0.48 of rating; P = 6.92^2 x 7.5 mOhm = 0.36 W; implied R_th = 20 K / (14.5^2 x 7.5 mOhm) = 12.7 K/W, so dT = 4.6 K; hotspot about 65 degC at 50 degC ambient with a 10 K local-air allowance (assumption A6), below the 70 degC at which the full V_R applies (above 85 degC TDK derates V_op by 1.33 %/degC; 105 degC case maximum). Alternates with the same 4-pin pattern: KEMET C4AQIBW5200A3JJ (20 uF +/-5 %, 800 V, I_rms 17.4 A on a dT = 30 K basis, ESR 4.7 mOhm, R_th 18 degC/W -> dT 4.1 K, dV/dt 13 V/us) and Vishay MKP1848C62080JP4 (20 uF +/-5 %, U_NDC 800 V at 85 degC, I_RMS 12 A at 10 kHz / 85 degC / dT 15 K, ESR 6 mOhm, dV/dt 35 V/us -> dT 5.0 K). Resulting ripple with C_min = 36 uF: 3.8 Vpp (0.95 %) at 27.5 A and 3.5 Vpp at 25 A; the ESR term is 3.75 mOhm x 44 A pk-pk capacitor current = 0.17 V.

### 3.4 Voltage rating (SKILL-003 principle 4)

Ratios: 440/800 = 0.55 continuous, 460/800 = 0.575 at the OVP trip, 480/800 = 0.60 for the 100 ms transient; against TDK V_op,85 = 700 V the transient ratio is 0.69. The 575 V class (ratios 0.77 / 0.83) was rejected for margin against commutation overshoot and for lifetime. KEMET and Vishay state 100,000 h at V_NDC / U_NDC and 70 degC hotspot; the voltage-lifetime curves in the datasheets must be read for the actual 0.55 ratio — no exponent is asserted because TI states no derating rule and the knowledge base does not contain one.

## 4. High-frequency ceramic tier (KR-CAP-003; KR-PCB-004; PE-PCB-002)

The film path has about 10 nH ESL per part plus 20-40 nH of interconnect. At the switching edges (about 31 A in 30-50 ns, roughly 1 A/ns) this would produce 20-40 V of bus droop/overshoot if the film had to supply the edge current. Ceramics beside the TO-247 pins supply the edge charge until the film path takes over, i.e. for about a quarter period of the film-to-ceramic resonance: with L_int = 30 nH and C_eff = 1.88 uF, f_r = 670 kHz, T/4 = 373 ns, dQ = 31.3 A x 373 ns = 11.7 uC and the dip is 6.2 V (1.5 %); with 1.0 uF effective it would be 8.5 V (2.1 %). Requirement: C_eff >= 1.5 uF at 440 V bias (assumption A5).

Selected: 10 x TDK CGA9P1X7T2J474M250KC (2220, 0.47 uF, 630 V, X7T, AEC-Q200, soft termination; the K250KC +/-10 % variant is interchangeable). Nominal 4.7 uF; counted as 1.88 uF assuming at most 60 % DC-bias loss at 440 V (assumption A4). The TDK datasheet plots the DC-bias characteristic with a 315 V reference point, but TDK's product page and the mirrored PDF could not be read (HTTP 403 / timeout), so the curve value is unverified and must be read before release. Alternate with lower bias loss and a 0.44 voltage ratio: Knowles 2220Y1K00474KXTWS2 (0.47 uF, 1 kV, X7R, 2220, FlexiCap). KEMET C2220C474KCRACTU is a 500 V part on KEMET's product page (ratio 0.88) and is rejected. Current in the ceramics: the 50 kHz share is 1.88/(36 + 1.88) = 5 %, i.e. 0.69 A total or 69 mA per piece; the HF edge current is about 1.3 A RMS total (triangular 50 ns edges), 0.13 A per piece — heating is negligible. Voltage ratio 440/630 = 0.70 (0.76 at 480 V) plus commutation overshoot: human review against the TDK rated-voltage definition. The film-to-ceramic resonance is lightly damped (Z0 about 0.13 Ohm versus 3.75 mOhm film ESR): keep L_int small; if simulation shows bus ringing, add a 1 uF + 0.47 Ohm RC damping leg (open issue).

## 5. Output bank

### 5.1 Requirements

I_Cout,rms = dI/sqrt(12) = 2.16 A (400 V, 267 uH) to 2.86 A (440 V, 220 uH). Ripple: dV = dI/(8 fs C) + ESR*dI -> C >= 12.5 uF for 2.0 Vpp with 1.8 mOhm bank ESR (not limiting). Load step (assumption A2: outer voltage-loop crossover fc = 2.5 kHz, i.e. fs/20 for a one-sample-delay digital loop with an inner average-current loop; the inductor slew limit (Vin - Vout)/L >= 0.6 A/us, 21 us for 12.5 A, is faster than the loop): dV = dI/(2 pi fc C) + ESR*dI -> C >= 79.8 uF at 2.5 kHz and 99.7 uF at 2.0 kHz; with -10 % tolerance 89-111 uF nominal. Selected 120 uF nominal (108 uF minimum). LC corner 889 Hz with 267 uH.

### 5.2 Technology comparison and selection

Film: 2 x TDK B32776G4606K000 (60 uF +/-10 %, V_R,70 = V_op,85 = 450 V DC, I_RMS 23.5 A, ESR 3.6 mOhm, ESL 14 nH, 30 x 45 x 42 mm, lead spacing 37.5 mm, P1 = 20.3 mm). Per part 1.43 A (0.06 of rating, 7 mW); ratios 200/450 = 0.44 and 220/450 = 0.49; a shorted high-side switch connects the 440 V bus to the output bank and 440/450 = 0.98 is survivable for the fuse-clearing interval (V_op,85 = 450 V); volume 113 cm3; distributor price not verified. Aluminium electrolytic: 2 x Nichicon LGW2E471MELB25 (470 uF, 250 V snap-in, 3.3 A at 50 kHz, 3000 h at 105 degC, 30 x 25 mm, about USD 4.7 at 10 pieces per the Digi-Key listing): 940 uF in 35 cm3, ratios 0.80 / 0.88, 10-K-rule estimate 48,000-96,000 h at 55-65 degC core — but the 50 kHz ESR was not found, lifetime modelling is outside the knowledge base, and the bank would vent under the high-side-short fault. Hybrid (1 x 20 uF film for the 50 kHz ripple plus 2 x 470 uF electrolytic for the step): lowest cost per microfarad, inherits the electrolytic limitations. Selection: all-film — robust at 50 degC, 100,000 h class without a lifetime model, fault tolerant, consistent with SKILL-003 and TIDA-010054. Alternates: Vishay MKP1848C66050JP* (60 uF, U_NDC 500 V, 18 A, 3 mOhm, 30 x 57 x 42 mm) or 3 x TDK B32776G4406K000 (40 uF, 450 V). Results with 108 uF: 12.5 A step -> 7.4 V at 2.5 kHz / 9.2 V at 2.0 kHz (<= 10 V); ripple 0.25 Vpp (0.12 %); full 25 A load dump -> +14.8 V (2.5 kHz) / +18.5 V (2.0 kHz), i.e. 215-218.5 V against the 220 V output OVP (open issue). Optional: 4 x 0.47 uF 630 V 2220 at the output terminals for HF noise/EMI (not needed for ripple).

## 6. Bleeder (discharge) resistors

Assumption A3: discharge to below 60 V within 60 s with a warning label, following the IEC 61800-5-1 clause 4.3.11 / IEC 62477-1 clause 4.4.9 option of a longer discharge time with marking; the 5 s option needs about 3 W of continuous dissipation or an active discharge circuit and is left for human review. Coupling: when Vin falls below Vout the high-side body diode conducts through L and the output bank discharges into the input bank, so both bleeders act on both banks. A two-bank ideal-diode simulation (C_in 48.7 uF including ceramics at +10 %, C_out 132 uF, start 460 V / 200 V) gives 35.7 s to below 60 V with R_in = 360 kOhm and R_out = 200 kOhm (input alone 35.7 s; output alone from 220 V 34.3 s). Input: 3 x Vishay CRCW2512120KFKEG in series (120 kOhm, 1 %, 1 W at 70 degC, 500 V limiting element voltage, datasheet 20035 rev 14-Apr-2026): 147 V / 160 V per resistor at 440 / 480 V, 0.54 W total at 440 V (0.18 W each, 18 % of P70; derating linear to zero at 155 degC film temperature). Output: 2 x CRCW2512100KFKEG (100 kOhm): 100 / 110 V each, 0.20 W total. Standby loss 0.74 W. Without bleeders the film self-discharge time constant exceeds 10,000 s. The input voltage-sense divider (SKILL-005 agent) adds a parallel path and is not credited.

## 8. Placement and PCB constraints (SKILL-002 principle 1; KR-PCB-004; KR-PCB-006; KR-ISO-002)

1. C_HF ceramics: first row within 5 mm, second row within 15 mm of the high-side drain and low-side source pins of the TO-247-4 pair, split on both sides of the device row; Vin+ and PGND as overlapping pours on adjacent layers under the ceramics; target commutation-loop inductance <= 20 nH including the two packages (about 20 V overshoot at 1 A/ns on a 1200 V device).
2. Film capacitors within 30-40 mm of the half-bridge, each on its own side, connected by Vin+ / PGND pours >= 20 mm wide (70 um copper: 1.4 mm2 per layer, 5 A/mm2 at 7 A RMS) repeated on at least two layers and stitched with via arrays (KR-PCB-006, PE-PCB-006); the four pins of each capacitor connect to both layers.
3. Custom KiCad footprints: a 4-pad pattern with pads at x = +/-18.75 mm, y = +/-5.10 mm (P1 10.2 mm) for the 20 uF parts and y = +/-10.15 mm (P1 20.3 mm) for the 60 uF parts; drill 1.6 mm, pad 3.0 mm for 1.2 mm leads; courtyards 28 x 42 mm and 30 x 45 mm plus clearance, heights 37 mm and 45 mm. The library C_Rect_L41.5mm_W*_P37.50mm footprints are 2-pin and do not fit; the 2-pin TDK "E" variants would fit but have 24-30 nH ESL and are not preferred.
4. Spacing: Vin+ to PGND working voltage 440 V DC (480 V transient): functional insulation, PD2, CTI >= 175 (group IIIa) — provisional >= 2.5 mm creepage and >= 1.5 mm clearance around capacitor pads and the bleeder chain, 3.0 mm recommended; the governing values are set by the isolation agent per KR-ISO-002 (human review); 2220 pad-to-pad gap is about 3.5-4 mm.
5. Bleeder chains routed as a straight series string along the capacitor edge, each resistor dropping <= 160 V, away from the gate-driver area; mark the discharge time near the input terminals.
6. Keep film capacitors and the bleeders out of the heat-sink exhaust airflow (SKILL-006 step 3); if the film capacitors sit downstream of the heat sink, re-evaluate the 10 K local-air allowance with a measurement.
7. If the architecture agent splits power and control boards, the whole capacitor set stays on the power board; only the bleeders and the sense divider interface matter for the control board.

## 10. Verification status

Analytically checked: input RMS current, ripple charge and capacitance at all nine corners; ESR and self-heating of all three film candidates against datasheet ratings; voltage ratios; HF-tier charge/dip model; output RMS, ripple and load-step capacitance; coupled bleeder discharge time and dissipation; copper current density. Verified against fetched datasheets: TDK B32776 (June 2026), KEMET C4AQ (6/2024) and C4AQ-M (8/2021), Vishay MKP1848C (rev 09-Aug-2023), Vishay CRCW e3 (rev 14-Apr-2026). Unverified: MLCC DC-bias curve and availability (TDK and Knowles pages blocked; Avnet shows zero stock / 168-week lead for the M250KC variant while SnapEda lists stock at Newark), Vishay 4-pin ordering-code digit, film-capacitor lifetime at the actual voltage ratio (curves not read), distributor prices, interconnect inductance (needs layout extraction), electrolytic 50 kHz ESR. Human review required: discharge-time option (60 s with label versus 5 s), creepage/clearance values per KR-ISO-002, output OVP threshold versus the load-dump excursion, 630 V versus 1 kV ceramic rating with overshoot, bus resonance damping, placement relative to the heat-sink exhaust, and the electrolytic option if cost pressure reopens it (lifetime modelling outside the knowledge base).
